title: Tokens, Embeddings and Attention
summary: Tokenisation, embeddings, positional encoding, scaled dot-product and multi-head attention.
objectives: Compute scaled dot-product attention by hand
Explain why positional information is needed
Describe the structure of a transformer block
socratic_prompts: What would attention compute if you shuffled the tokens and used no positional encoding?
Why must each row of attention weights sum to one?

examples.title: Attention weights
examples.code:
import numpy as np
q = np.array([1., 0.]); K = np.array([[1., 0.], [0., 1.]])
s = K @ q / np.sqrt(2)
print(np.exp(s) / np.exp(s).sum())
